name: Toaru Shoujo no Koi Gatari
source:
Hey, will you lend me an ear? I want to fall in love.

A kinetic novel that is just under five minutes.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4643]Freem[/url]]
translation:
嘿，能听我说说吗？我想谈一场恋爱。

一部时长不到5分钟的短篇视觉小说。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4643]Freem[/url]]
